children.text: The Black Division is a highly skilled, mysterious, and elite tactical unit in Escape from Tarkov lore, primarily acting as the clandestine, elite "cleanup crew" for TerraGroup. Known for appearing in the
series (Episode 5) and appears as a major threat only on the

value.name: Terminal
value.description: The southern port Terminal has been under Russian Armed Forces control since the beginning of the Tarkov conflict. After the city was sealed off, the terminal was fortified and became the primary evacuation point, sought by both civilian refugees and PMC units. According to unconfirmed reports, TerraGroup personnel were also evacuated through this port.

children.text: map, they represent a professional, western-equipped force that annihilates all witnesses.
Found only on the Terminal and Icebreaker location, added in the 1.0 release
Operate as a team, flank, and use grenades
Play around cover, use quick peeks.
Lure them one by one, avoid fighting all at once.
Force movement and break their positioning.
They are predictable through footsteps and actions.
